annotation.title_clean: Socially interactive industrial robots: a PAD model of flow for emotional co-regulation
annotation.title_en: Socially interactive industrial robots: a PAD model of flow for emotional co-regulation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Nunnari, F.; Tsovaltzi, D.; Lavit Nicora, M.; Beyrodt, S.; Prajod, P.; Chehayeb, L. et al.
annotation.summary_en: Peer-reviewed technical and empirical paper presenting a socially interactive industrial cobot with an avatar (covatar) and the transparent BASSF emotion model using PAD signals to co-regulate worker boredom and stress. Two user studies (N=20, N=12) support wellbeing benefits. It contains no governance provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Introduces the BASSF explainable model of worker emotion (Boredom, Anxiety, Self-efficacy, Self-compassion, Flow) in PAD space
Dominance predicts self-efficacy and flow in assembly tasks with cobots
PAD signals need pre-filtering and per-user calibration
Socially interactive cobots can support worker wellbeing and job satisfaction
Part of the EU MindBot project on worker mental health with cobots
